# Vendored agent skills

Everything under this directory is copied verbatim from upstream repositories by
`.github/scripts/sync-skills.mjs`. Do not edit these files - changes are overwritten on the next sync.

To change what is vendored, edit `.github/skills-sources.json` and re-run the Sync Skills workflow.
